title: 212 GB: how to make sure GTA 6 is ready at midnight
summary: Pre-load has been open since 10 November. Boxed copies only contain a code, so everyone has to download.
body: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB of free space, depending on your console. Leave extra room: two pre-release updates already landed on 13 and 16 November.
- Pre-load is live since 10 November for digital copies
- Boxed edition = download code, no disc. Redeem the code now and start the pre-load
- Keep the console in rest mode with downloads allowed so updates install automatically
- Internet providers have warned that pre-load traffic is slowing connections, so do not wait until midnight
Reported versions after the 16 November update: PS5 1.002.001, Xbox 1.0.2.1.
